A very good sequel to the previous EAFC, FC26. A new gamemode of FC27 compared to FC26 is 'the grounds'. Basically a social hub that allows you to play against other players from around the world (or regionally, I don't actually know). One downside is that it makes clubs a lot more confusing. It makes leveling up your clubs player a very confusing series of steps (I don't actually know how to). Apart from the grounds, manager career has taken a huge step up. There is a lot more realism in transfers. And EA, please take this as feedback, but player career for me hasn't been good since FIFA 23. I liked the request for transfer listing a bit more than the agent stuff. I'm not saying that the agent/my pro section is bad, but I'm just saying that I preferred the 'request a transfer listing'. Another thing that I don't really like with it is that when you do a make your pro player career, I liked the old skill point system better because now it makes your development a lot harder. Overall, the game is a pretty solid upgrade from FC26, but even after like one day of playing, I've gotten a bit bored. 

My Overall rating:
8/10

Review by a 12-13 wins player.

The game is just being developed for the ADHD generation. Defense is laughably bad, the AI either runs after players that would run offside and follows them, opening up giant spaces. Or they dont move at all and watch as your opponent R1 dribbles past them. Game balancing is terrible. Defending is still so slow while the attacker can spin around 3 times before you can move from left to right.

Every game ends 6:5 or 7:6. Just a few years ago attacking was still a skill where you needed to break down low blocks with good passing. Games ended 2:1 or 3:1. But players on average are awful so they needed to make it extremely easy to score goals.

The biggest problem of every Fifa game are the meta slaves that suck any fun out of the experience:

On day 1 I already faced teams with 5'1 women, fidget spinning in the midfield until they can play a single pass that breaks down my entire defense. For a few years now this game has not reflected any sort of football simulation. It is probably the most arcady experience on the market.

And yet I still need to buy it because there are no competitors

Probably the best version EA released since 23. The manual defending and through balls is defenitely a good change from previous titles. The nerf on low driven and finesse while buffing the keepers adds more variation on how you score. The lack of assistance on the gameplay really is a breath of fresh air.

On the bad side though, most visual and audio bugs were not fixed. Obviously the inconsistent server won't ever get fixed too. Odd ball rebounds are still a thing though it's been improved. All in all, it's not the best game ever but it's a step towards the right direction for EA.

**EA actually cooked with this one. 🔥**

I’ve played FIFA/FC since FIFA 21, and I genuinely thought FC 26 was the worst game in the series.

But after playing FC 27 for a day… I’m impressed.

The gameplay feels **way smoother and more balanced**, and defending being more manual actually makes your skill matter. You can’t just rely on the game to defend for you anymore — if you’re good, you win. If you make mistakes, you get punished.

EA said they’re not going to mess with the core gameplay, so PLEASE just leave it alone. 😭

It’s only been one day, so things can obviously change, but so far this is easily my favorite FIFA/FC since FIFA 21.

**EA, don’t fumble this.**

**W.**

Most certainly the worst FIFA of the entire franchise. The passing is atrocious, defending is far too easy that even the worst players strip of you of possession with minimal effort. And if you do manage to dispossess the opposing team, they immediately recover the ball from you and that's how 90% of goals are scored. If you're looking to skip a FIFA for a year, this is the one to do it. But I'm glad they put all this effort into 'The Grounds' instead of making the foundation of gameplay good. What a horrible allocation of time and resources just to squander it on something no one wanted, and will hope they never see again. Starting to wonder if they even played their game before dumping this agonizing punishment to the masses...
